name: Hikari
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c147194]Astera[/url] during her lifetime. A quiet and intelligent girl who grew up in the same orphanage as [url=https://vndb.org/c147241]Mirei[/url]. Before being sent to the orphanage, she was raised by her grandfather. Initially, she preferred to keep to herself and refrained from communicating with others. However, through her interactions with Mirei, she gradually developed a more kind and caring heart.
